questions.question: What does "failed" mean for these forks?

options.label: Tried to resume, claude -r errored or showed wrong content
options.description: You ran `claude -r <new_id>` and it didn't load the transcript, or loaded the wrong session. Means the jsonl is malformed or in the wrong project dir.

options.label: Forks open but cwd is the bridge worktree, not main
options.description: The forks resume into `.claude/worktrees/bridge-cse_*` instead of `~/dev/ai-harness`. Original fork was done WITHOUT `--into-main`. Fix: re-fork with --into-main into the main checkout.

options.label: Source cse_ is stuck disconnected, blocking something
options.description: The forks themselves are fine, but the source cse_ sessions need to be archived/cleaned up and that step failed. Fix: archive the sources (needs new code).

options.label: Something else
options.description: None of the above — you'll explain.

2. **Wait** and build `fork-all` first so it's a one-shot on note.
